hints.tr: `&self.name` alanı ödünç verir; `self.name` sahipliği verir (çünkü `self` alındı).
hints.en: `&self.name` lends the field; `self.name` gives ownership (because `self` was taken).

tests.code: let p = Person { name: String::from("Ada") }; assert_eq!(p.name(), "Ada"); assert_eq!(p.name(), "Ada");
let p = Person { name: String::from("Ada") }; let s: String = p.into_name(); assert_eq!(s, "Ada");
